BoltZip uses the unmodified 7-Zip 26.06 ARM64 macOS command-line program
(7zz) as a separate process for encrypted 7z archives.

7-Zip Copyright (C) 1999-2026 Igor Pavlov.
7-Zip is licensed under GNU LGPL 2.1 or later. Some components also use the
BSD 2-clause and BSD 3-clause licenses or have the unRAR restriction.
See License.txt and LGPL-2.1.txt for the complete license notices.

Official project: https://www.7-zip.org/
Release: https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases/tag/26.06
Corresponding source:
https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases/download/26.06/7z2606-src.tar.xz
Source archive SHA-256:
a4e374c8f864f51df48c2cfd0e1413ec3b2ea030deae852d6a655402ebb61ac4

The 7zz executable and License.txt were extracted from the release artifact:
https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases/download/26.06/7z2606-mac.tar.xz
Binary archive SHA-256:
b6f17920b4240940461dac8ef4009891881ac44d2a5ead625ede2ec8472185dd

After verifying the archive SHA-256 above, extract 7zz and License.txt
with `tar -xf 7z2606-mac.tar.xz 7zz License.txt`. Verify the extracted
executable with `shasum -a 256 -c 7zz.sha256` in this directory.
BoltZip's packaging process signs its bundled copy of 7zz for macOS.
